# PseudoInv

![PseudoInv function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/17-pseudoinverse.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Computes the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse by SVD, output n by m. Values at or below the absolute tolerance are not inverted. Negative cutoff selects max(m,n)*epsilon*sigma_max (explicit GS automatic policy). Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: tolerance=-1.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**PseudoInv**

Calcule la pseudo-inverse de Moore–Penrose par SVD, de dimension n×m. Les valeurs singulières sous le seuil ne sont pas inversées ; un seuil négatif active le seuil automatique GS. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : tolerance=-1.

</details>
